indexed_scope: The 11 active documents from the 12-file chunking pilot sample.
split_method: Manual stratified split encoded in stable question IDs; 16 answerable and 16 unanswerable items in each split. The holdout file is materialized before calibration and its labels are not accepted by the calibration API.
manual_review: Every supporting passage was checked against normalization-manifest.jsonl. Exact nonexistent identifiers were also checked by literal search of the pinned docs tree without normalizing or embedding additional pages.
